verdict.rationale: The pack documents no official SDK (no client libraries, language bindings, or SDK reference docs) that a developer can build against. It shows only adjacent surfaces: the Public API with an OpenAPI/Swagger spec, the CLI with `bw serve`, and an official MCP server. These are APIs and tools rather than SDKs. The only SDK reference is a passing community remark about a relicensing controversy, which does not document a buildable SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
